notes.title: Story Update
notes.content:
An update has been released, which focuses on the main story for the game. It also improves art in some areas as well.

If you find any bugs, let me know and I'll be sure to fix them quickly. Thanks!

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

Beyond the QoL and bug fixes that are added in every update, this update focuses on dungeons. 14+ more dungeons have been added to loot and fight your way through. They were created with leveling in mind, so as your character grows, the dungeons will become more challenging. 

I hope you enjoy the game!
